notes.subject: נקה
notes.rationale: piel 'avenge their blood' vs 'declare innocent' — JPS 'hold as innocent'; dual sense of clean/acquit and punish.

notes.subject: skelim ol
notes.rationale: piel נקיתי rendered 'skelim ol' (judge/avenge); literal is 'make clean'.

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs object marker where Hebrew uses verb valence alone.

translation: Na bai mi skelim ol long ⟨em⟩ blut bilong ol, we mi no skelim ol yet; na Yahwe i stap skul long ⟨em⟩ Tsiyon.

tokens.gloss: na bai mi skelim ol long
